title: Blackwade's shop is open again
items: You can buy equipment and upgrades in Blackwade again. They are how you get further, so that shop stays open.
Your coins and everything you owned were never touched.
The shops that only sell looks (Chromeline, Spire's coin hats, Asteroid Run and Starhop) stay closed for now.

es.Blackwade's shop is open again: La tienda de Blackwade vuelve a estar abierta
es.You can buy equipment and upgrades in Bl: Ya puedes volver a comprar equipo y mejoras en Blackwade. Son la forma de avanzar, así que esa tienda sigue abierta.
es.Your coins and everything you owned were: Tus monedas y todo lo que tenías no se tocaron nunca.
es.The shops that only sell looks (Chromeli: Las tiendas que solo venden aspectos (Chromeline, los sombreros de monedas de Spire, Asteroid Run y Starhop) siguen cerradas por ahora.
